Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details how to use Google Search Console for performance reporting, non-branded click analysis using Regex, technical indexation audits (discovered/crawled currently not indexed), backlink profile tracking, video indexing troubleshooting, and evaluating generative AI overview impressions. modules: [MEA] topics: [seo analytics, rank tracking, site auditing] tier: 3 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. seo analytics / Evaluating high-level search performance using Google Search Console metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, average position). Isolating true organic growth by filtering out branded search terms using Custom Regex (doesn't match combined with pipe symbols for "or"). Identifying content gaps and new content opportunities by exporting Search Console query data to find terms the site surfaces for without dedicated coverage. rank tracking / Monitoring page and keyword positioning over time without paid rank trackers by filtering performance reports by exact query or specific URLs, and using comparison modes to measure rank shifts. Tracking emerging AI-driven search presence through Google's generative AI performance report (covering AI Overviews and AI mode impressions). site auditing / Troubleshooting indexation issues via the URL inspection tool and pages report. Differentiating between "Discovered - currently not indexed" (Google knows the page exists but hasn't crawled yet) and "Crawled - currently not indexed" (Google read the page and passed due to thin or duplicate content signals). Checking video indexing rules (ensuring videos live on dedicated "watch pages" rather than embedded halfway down a post) and reviewing baseline backlink and internal linking reports.

Look for. The definition of "Discovered - currently not indexed": Google knows the page exists but hasn't crawled it yet. The definition of "Crawled - currently not indexed": Google read the page and chose to pass on it, usually indicating content quality or thinness issues. The specific regex method to filter out branded terms: using doesn't match with brand terms separated by a pipe symbol (|). The rule for Google video indexing: the video must be the main event of the page on a dedicated "watch page."
Skip. Promotional walkthroughs for signing up for or configuring third-party content optimization tools like Surfer. General introductory overviews of Google Search Console's dashboard navigation.
